purpose: Immutable native source inputs for core:audio. scripts/fetch-native-sources.sh verifies every SHA-256 before extracting, and never downloads during an ordinary build.

sources.name: miniaudio
sources.role: WAV decoding, channel/rate conversion, test-tone waveform generation and WAV encoding for the host harness. Device I/O is disabled; AudioTrack owns playback.
sources.modifications: None. Single-header dependency compiled into core:audio.
buildFlags: MA_NO_ENCODING disabled for the host harness only
